title: Masdar al Hayat for Food Industries
description: masdar.sa Masdar Al Hayat Food Industries, maker of the Fonte brand, is a Saudi food company founded in 2009 in Riyadh's Second Industrial City and owned by the Tamimi Group. Led by CEO Mohammed Abdullah bin Mahfouz, it produces bakery and confectionery products including its flagship tortillas, toast bread, burger buns, arabic bread, cupcakes, Swiss rolls, family cakes and sugar paste decorations. Certified to ISO 22000, HACCP and Halal standards, it runs a factory in Riyadh and an eastern province plant opened around 2021, with 100 to 150 employees. Products are sold through major chains like Panda, Tamimi Markets, Noon Minutes and Spinneys plus its own retail outlets across Saudi Arabia. Recent moves include a 2025 partnership with Manga Productions of Misk Foundation to put Saudi anime characters from Legends of the Future on packaging, a supply contract with listed firm Shumou Al Madi for Fonte chocolate wafers, and date products developed with the National Center for Palms.
